integrity: The proof is symbolic; a standalone exhaustive residue-covering check for exponents 2 through 30 is included only as corroboration.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats idealizations over Z by finite abelian groups, not arbitrary base rings.
It resolves the cited domination conjecture only for this family.
The mixed-prime condition is required only to place the family in the non-ideal-zero-divisor case.
title: Finite torsion idealizations of \(\mathbb Z\) realize the conjectured total-graph domination bound
